en.title: Jason Bateman's Crime-Comedy 'The Cackling of the Dodos' Officially Wraps Filming
en.summary: Sam Rockwell and Woody Harrelson are set to star in Jason Bateman's latest directorial project for Netflix. The crime-comedy, officially wrapped, promises a darkly humorous tale of a farmer caught in a disastrous cover-up.
en.body:
The cameras have officially stopped rolling on **Jason Bateman**'s upcoming Netflix Original crime-comedy, **‘The Cackling of the Dodos’**. This marks another directorial venture for Bateman, who has honed his skills on projects like **Ozark** and **Black Rabbit**, while also delivering memorable performances in **Arrested Development** and **Carry On**. The film brings together a powerhouse duo in **Sam Rockwell** and **Woody Harrelson**, reuniting the acclaimed co-stars of **Three Billboards Outside Ebbing, Missouri**.

Penned by novelist **Rye Curtis**, known for **Kingdomtide**, the film's plot plunges into a decidedly grim, yet darkly comedic, scenario. The official synopsis reveals that the story centers on George, a small-town farmer who experiences a truly terrible day. His predicament begins when he discovers a corpse chilling in a grain bin, an event that quickly spirals as his boss, Denny, unwittingly forces him into a chaotic and sloppy cover-up. Rockwell is set to embody the hapless farmer George, while Harrelson will play the untrustworthy boss, Denny. Bateman himself has expressed his enthusiasm for directing Rockwell, hinting at the actor's natural talent and the need for Bateman to stay sharp on set.

## Bateman Directs Rockwell and Harrelson

The collaboration between these seasoned actors and Bateman behind the camera is precisely what has fans buzzing. Bateman's track record, particularly his work on **Ozark**, showcases his ability to navigate complex narratives with a blend of tension and dark humor, often drawing out nuanced performances from his cast. The chemistry between Rockwell and Harrelson is legendary, and the prospect of them tackling a crime-comedy penned by a novelist like Curtis suggests a script with potential for sharp dialogue and unexpected twists. It’s a combination that speaks directly to viewers who appreciate well-crafted genre films with strong character work and a distinct directorial voice.

## What Fans Are Saying

While concrete details about the film’s release are still under wraps, the wrap on filming is a significant milestone for those eagerly awaiting Bateman's next project. Fans of **Sam Rockwell** and **Woody Harrelson** are particularly excited, given their previous electrifying on-screen partnership. The crime-comedy genre, especially when infused with Bateman's signature style, has a dedicated following who are always on the lookout for their next binge-worthy obsession. The promise of a sloppy cover-up involving a corpse in a grain bin is exactly the kind of intriguing, slightly absurd premise that sparks curiosity and anticipation within the community of series and film fans.

## What's Next

With principal photography now complete, **‘The Cackling of the Dodos’** will move into its post-production phase. Details regarding a release date on Netflix have not yet been announced, but fans can expect more information to emerge as the film nears its debut. In the meantime, viewers can revisit Bateman's previous work on Netflix, including **Ozark** and **Carry On**, to get a taste of his directorial and acting prowess.

content_raw: Picture Credit: Getty Images Jason Bateman has officially wrapped filming on his latest directorial effort, the upcoming Netflix Original crime-comedy The Cackling of the Dodos . Starring Sam Rockwell and Woody Harrelson, the plot centers on a small-town farmer forced into a sloppy cover-up by his boss. Now that cameras have stopped rolling, here is our updated guide to everything we know about The Cackling of the Dodos on Netflix. The Cackling of the Dodos is an upcoming Netflix Original crime comedy film directed by Jason Bateman, who has previously starred in Netflix’s Carry-On and Arrested Development, and has also directed episodes and played lead roles in Ozark and Black Rabbit . The film is written by novelist Rye Curtis ( Kingdomtide ). What is the plot of The Cackling of the Dodos ? Netflix has provided an official synopsis for The Cackling of the Dodos : “Dodos centers on small-town farmer George, who has a truly terrible day when he discovers a corpse chilling out in a grain bin and is unwittingly forced into a chaotic, sloppy cover-up by his boss, Denny.” Who is in the cast of The Cackling of the Dodos ? When the film was first announced, we only knew of two major attachments: Sam Rockwell and Woody Harrelson , who previously worked together on the acclaimed film Three Billboards Outside Ebbing, Missouri. It has since been confirmed that Rockwell will be playing the farmer, George, while Harrelson takes on the role of his untrustworthy boss, Denny. During a recent July 2026 episode of his SmartLess podcast, Bateman spoke highly of directing Rockwell. After a guest shared a story about a brilliant flash-memorization acting trick, Bateman playfully admitted he had to stay on his toes with his lead actor : “He’s a real crafty bugger. I’m gonna keep my knees bent”. Joining the lead duo is a stellar supporting cast: Fred Hechinger ( Kraven the Hunter , Gladiator II ) Michael McKean ( Better Call Saul , This Is Spinal Tap ) Esther McGregor ( Babygirl ) Jenn Lyon ( Justified , Claws ) Emy Coligado ( Malcolm in the Middle ) Darrin Baker ( The Man from Toronto ) as Officer Hopkins Steve Routman ( Killers of the Flower Moon ) as Dr. Leishman Nigel J.
